items.essentialIdea: The cell membrane selectively allows some substances to cross more easily than others.

check.title: Membrane passage
check.prompt: How does the cell membrane control what enters and leaves the cell?
check.referenceAnswer: It is selectively permeable, so some substances cross more easily than others while many are limited or blocked.
check.feedback: The key relationship is selective passage, not total openness or total blockage.

items.essentialIdea: Osmosis is the net movement of water across a selectively permeable membrane from higher water concentration to lower water concentration.

check.title: Water movement in osmosis
check.prompt: What is osmosis, and in what direction does water move?
check.referenceAnswer: Osmosis is the net movement of water across a selectively permeable membrane from higher water concentration to lower water concentration.
check.feedback: Osmosis concerns water only, and the net movement goes from higher to lower water concentration.

check.feedback: The key relationship is selective passage, not total openness or total blockage.

items.essentialIdea: Osmosis is the net movement of water across a selectively permeable membrane from higher water concentration to lower water concentration.

check.title: Water movement in osmosis
check.prompt: What is osmosis, and in what direction does water move?
check.referenceAnswer: Osmosis is the net movement of water across a selectively permeable membrane from higher water concentration to lower water concentration.
check.feedback: Osmosis concerns water only, and the net movement goes from higher to lower water concentration.

recognitionCheck.title: Recognize osmosis
choices: Net movement of water across a selectively permeable membrane from higher water concentration to lower water concentration

recognitionCheck.correctAnswer: Net movement of water across a selectively permeable membrane from higher water concentration to lower water concentration
recognitionCheck.feedback: Osmosis is specifically water movement across a selectively permeable membrane, not solute movement or unrestricted diffusion.
